rationale: Used a sparse isolated BioStack worktree at the exact current origin/main commit so the plan could be grounded in repository evidence without touching implementation work.
Selected a documentation-only lane because the current audit remains NO-GO / HOLD and marketing execution would require missing live evidence and human approvals.
Favored owned, proof-led, high-intent preparation over broad paid acquisition because it is lower cost and easier to keep within the non-prescriptive claims boundary.

alternatives_rejected.reason: The release, legal, privacy, billing, security, operational, accessibility, analytics, and support gates are not closed.
Paid scale is not justified before privacy-safe activation, conversion, retention, support, and cohort evidence exists.
BioStack is observational and non-prescriptive; outcome, compatibility, dosing, diagnosis, and treatment claims exceed the verified product boundary.
